result.summary: Found 1 issue: a persistent loading spinner is overlaid on a restaurant card, obscuring the food image.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner is displayed directly on top of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image in the 'Popular right now' section, covering the ramen bowl and making the card look broken or unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the spinner is removed once the image finishes loading, or use a skeleton/placeholder background instead of an overlaid spinner so the card content remains visible.
